===Act initium: Hour of an Awakening===
The Doctor was awakened from the [[Chernobog]] Sarcophagus by a [[Rhodes Island]] team led by Amiya, but thanks to their amnesia, the Doctor cannot remember anything prior to their awakening. Not long after, the Sarcophagus was attacked by [[Reunion]], and the Doctor instantly recalls some strategies and tactics they had as a field commander and were able to led R.I. into victory over the Reunion in this small skirmish. After rendezvousing with [[Ace]], a close friend of the Doctor and an Elite Operator, the Doctor continues leading R.I. through the chaos that ensues all over Chernobog, including a Catastrophe that struck the crippled [[nomadic city]]. Just before they made it out of Chernobog, the R.I. forces encountered W who recognizes the Doctor, but she let R.I. retreat, due to a secret agreement she made with Scout.

===Act 1: Shatter of a Vision===
The Doctor has since accompanied Amiya and the bulk of R.I.'s paramilitary force throughout their cooperation with [[Lungmen Guard Department]]. At an operation to relieve a trapped R.I. reconnaissance squad, the Doctor and R.I. face off against [[FrostNova]] and her [[Yeti Squadron]], culminating in a battle which ended with them and FrostNova being trapped in the rubble of a collapsing street. The Doctor saves FrostNova from the rubble, and while waiting for their rescue, listens to the [[Cautus]]' tale of her past, which made the Doctor sympathize her. After they were rescued, the Doctor and FrostNova parted ways peacefully, but she warned them that she won't hesitate fighting them again if they were ever meet face-to-face once more.

The Doctor continues accompanying Amiya and the R.I. forces, [[Blaze]] and [[GreyThroat]] being part of the forces, through the counter-attack against Reunion who had attacked [[Lungmen]] and the subsequent "clean-up" operation. They also notably saw through [[Wei Yenwu]]'s cunning strategy, which they can either rebuke for or simply ignore it. At the climax, the Doctor and FrostNova meet each other once more, which ended in a desperate fight. With FrostNova defeated and dying, the Doctor stays on her side throughout her last moments, and comforts her by saying her [[Patriot|father]] really loves her. Then Doctor accepts her into R.I. before the Cautus dies in their arms. The Doctor then took FrostNova's body back to the ''Rhodes Island'' where she is then cremated in an incineration chamber overseen by [[Rosmontis]] at first.

The Doctor led the R.I. in the operation to stop Chernobog from colliding with Lungmen, during which they were outraged that someone as young as Rosmontis was being made to use such a disturbing method of combat, and demands to know who deployed Rosmontis to fight, to which Rosmontis tells Doctor that she herself chose to be on this mission. After she says this, the Doctor calms down, and the mission proceeds. The Doctor commanded R.I. as they fought the Guerrillas and later, [[Patriot]], witnessing the ordeal between the last Wendigo and Amiya. The group now has to split up, and Kal'tsit says the Doctor needs to go with her to the Chernobog Sarcophagus. Along the way, they run into W, during which the Sarkaz mercenary and Kal'tsit are revealed to know each other, and they vaguely talk about Kal'tsit working with the Doctor, and W reveals how the Doctor is the third (first being [[Talulah]], and second being [[Theresis]]) on her "hit-list", since she wants to torture them for answers before she kills them. After Kal'tsit's decides the conversation is leading nowhere, she has [[Mon3tr]] grab W like a rag-doll, and take W through the walls to where she needed to go.

As the Doctor and Kal'tsit travels through the tunnels leading to the Sarcophagus, they witnessed a horde of [[Possessed]] including some Sarkaz mercenaries, before encountering the source of the Possessed: [[Mephisto]], now transformed into [[Mephisto, The Singer|an avian monster]]. The Doctor and Kal'tsit recognized Mephisto but nonetheless Doctor followed Kal'tsit's suggestion to put him out of his misery once and for all. At some point in the aftermath of the battle, Kal'tsit leaves the fate of Mephisto, who turned out to have survived the encounter, to the Doctor's verdict; put Mephisto out of his misery, or try to give him a comfortable life until his soon inevitable end to [[Oripathy]] However, the player never gets to make the decision for the Doctor, nor get to see what the Doctor decides, leaving Mephisto's ultimate fate unknown. Kal'tsit then revealed facts about the Sarcophagus to the Doctor and that she truly hates the Doctor for murdering Theresa, but her promise with Theresa is the only reason Kal'tsit refrains from killing the Doctor. Around this point the Doctor suddenly starts to vaguely remember things that happened at the Sarcophagus, but their memory becomes far more clear when they hear a voice, and then see a woman holding the Doctor's hand, while promising that Doctor and her will meet again. At the end of the memory, the Doctor is able to recognize the woman, who is none other than [[Priestess]].

[[File:Amiya and the Doctor.png|thumb|The Doctor and Amiya in ''Rhodes Island's'' bridge in the aftermath of the Chernobog-Lungmen crisis]]
Kal'tsit and the Doctor meets up with Amiya at Chernobog's control tower just as the collision is stopped after she and Ch'en had talked down Talulah, however Amiya suddenly went unconscious. Kal'tsit then uses the Doctor's blood to make a solution that healed Amiya, and told them that R.I. will take Talulah to their custody; the Doctor agreed after hearing Kal'tsit's explanation. Upon returning to R.I., the Doctor asked Kal'tsit to include FrostNova as a member of R.I.; she accepts after initially refusing to do so. The Doctor then talks with Amiya as they observe the view from the ''Rhodes Island's'' bridge, to which the Doctor can agree to Amiya vowing to have R.I. press forward no matter what lies ahead; alternatively, the Doctor can ask Amiya what she would do if they were a bad person, to which she vows to stop them herself.

===Heart of Surging Flame===
The Doctor and Amiya goes to [[Siesta]] per Kal'tsit's recommendation. Both of them were excited just like the entire tourist population who came for the Obsidian Music Festival. Tagging along with them are several operators: [[Sora]], [[Provence]], [[Skyfire]] and Gummy. A broadcast from a Catastrophe Messenger named [[Cronin]] caught their attention when he stated that it is believed that Siestan Obsidian can keep Oripathy "at bay". Amiya, however was wary about how dismissive he is in regards to science. Skyfire affirmed her sentiment and told them that she and Provence will scout the volcano. They met Gummy afterwards who's currently opening a food stall, upon seeing her being interested, the Doctor told Amiya to help Gummy, which she reluctantly obliged. A dark-haired Feline later approached the Doctor, telling them that they're dressed oddly in a city like Siesta. One of her men later called her that Cronin is looking for her and she left the Doctor. An urgent message later came from Provence who said that Siesta's in danger.<ref>[[OF-ST1]]</ref>

Provence then briefed the Doctor that the Siesta Volcano is still active and how they saved the mayor's daughter, [[Ceylon]]. Provence then proceeded to tell her findings that it is very likely the volcano is going to erupt soon. She also explained that the volcano contains Originium which might made Siesta a place to look out for mining companies. Ceylon then confirmed her findings matches with what the Siestan officials have known and asked their help to save Siesta.<ref>[[OF-1/Story]]</ref> Provence then called [[Eyjafjalla]] who estimated that the volcano is going to erupt in 2–4 weeks. Ceylon, impressed with Eyjafjalla's findings, lamented that she should've jotted down her explanation while the Doctor seems confused. Provence then asked the Doctor's permission to return to the volcano with Skyfire tagging along her. Ceylon then asked the Doctor to prepare everything and meet her in the Town Hall at 2PM.<ref>[[OF-ST2]]</ref> En route to the Town Hall, both of them saw [[Destructive Dragon Demon|D.D.D]] hyping up the crowd which also excites them with Ceylon noting that this is the usual sight for Obsidian Music Festival. After being presented with sufficient data, Cronin, instead accused the Doctor of trying to dupe Ceylon and his bodyguard tried to attack them. They tried to run away and met the dark-haired Feline who Ceylon called [[Schwarz]]. She told Ceylon that her father is currently out of town and she had to listen to Cronin which confused her.<ref>[[OF-2/Story]]</ref>

Ceylon refused to listen to her and the Doctor urged her to run. Schwarz tried to chase them but was blocked by [[Hellagur]]. They managed to run all the way to the beach but the bodyguards managed to catch up to them. Before they can do anything to them however, [[Ifrit]] showed up and fended the bodyguards off. The Doctor told her to not go overboard. Ceylon later thanked her and Ifrit asked the Doctor not to tell Silence over what happened. They reunited with Hellagur later.<ref>[[OF-3/Story]]</ref> Hellagur later recounted her confrontation with Schwarz, noting that she's not ordinary but her men however is mediocre at best. Hellagur later divulged her identity to which the Doctor said that Siesta has a hidden, darker side. Unbeknownst to them, Ceylon heard all of these stories which shaken her. Ceylon then told her past with Schwarz but she wondered if she's living in an illusion. The Doctor assured that she herself is a skilled researcher and nothing she's done is in vain. Ceylon plans to use the amusement's park broadcast tower to send the evacuation message but it is heavily guarded by Cronin's men and she asked the Doctor and Hellagur's help. The Doctor, with [[Vigna]]'s help, barged in the broadcast room.<ref>[[OF-5/Story]]</ref> Vigna singlehandedly defeats all of Cronin's men but Cronin escaped by jumping out of the window only to be intercepted by Hellagur. [[Herman Doykos|The mayor]] then revealed that he only pretended to be out of town and asked Schwarz to investigate him. He then ordered Cronin to be jailed but a massive tremor then strikes the city. The Doctor then ordered all operators to help with evacuation but Eyjafjalla and Provence called them to say they found a solution.<ref>[[OF-7/Story]]</ref>

Amiya later scolded them for being involved in the events but she understood the reasoning behind their actions. Herman Doykos later thanked them for their actions and talked about Siesta's future plans and his daughter. Ceylon later told them she's interested in joining Rhodes Island with Schwarz tagging along as her bodyguard.<ref>[[OF-ST5]]</ref>

===The Great Chief Returns===
The event starts with the Doctor dreaming nonsensical stuffs until [[Ceobe]] and [[Gavial]] managed to woke them up. It was revealed that on the way to Gavial's hometown their aircraft was attacked by some Acahuallan tribesmen who somehow managed to get ahold of anti-air weapons. They found out these tribesmen were surrounding [[Lancet-2]] who is still in the aircraft when it crashed down. After beating them down and revealing her name, the tribesmen ran away telling Gavial they have to report to [[Eunectes]]. Suddenly, an Archosauria girl called [[Tomimi]] ran to Gavial and warmly hugged her. She later told Gavial that Zumama or Eunectes is in the temple preparing for the ceremony. Lancet-2 and the pilot Dylan decided they will stay in the aircraft and the rest will go to Acahuallan jungle but Ceobe suddenly consumed a hallucinogenic mushroom and started talking nonsense, much to Gavial's dismay who told Lancet-2 to tie her up and look after her.<ref>[[RI-1/Story]]</ref>

During their trek in the jungle, Gavial asked the Doctor how did they feel last night during their sleep. Tomimi then recounted the Acahuallan tribe's history and the Doctor, who never knew about such custom asked Gavial who in return told them that she beat everyone up. When Tomimi asked if Gavial is really not going to be a chief, the Doctor affirmed that Gavial had things to do outside Acahualla. When they arrived at Gavial's tribe territory she recognized AUS' music played in the are which the Doctor and Tomimi confirms much to her surprise and bewilderment. Tomimi clarified later that the band indeed came to their area some time ago to hold concerts.<ref>[[RI-2/Story]]</ref> Tomimi then told the Doctor about Gavial's life in the tribe including the fact that she's an orphan, a fact that nobody really knows. The Doctor then praised Gavial which she rejects saying she needs no pity. However, their talk is interrupted by a now or perhaps still hallucinating Ceobe who suddenly appeared. Tomimi, confused by the sight, asked the Doctor about Gavial's life outside the jungle. Tomimi recounted all of Gavial's fight during the previous ceremony. She also told them about Gavial's relationship with Zumama.<ref>[[RI-3/Story]]</ref>

Gavial then goes to meet Zumama where the Doctor inquired further about the Ceremony. Tomimi is surprised to learn Gavial is going to fight her but the Doctor instead replied that it's not surprising at all.<ref>[[RI-4/Story]]</ref> When Gavial found out Zumama constructed her own machine armor, Tomimi asked the Doctor if Rhodes Island is filled with stuffs like that which they confirmed. It's also revealed that the tribesmen took away the aircraft engine and they have to retrieve it back.<ref>[[BI-ST-1]]</ref> Gavial then took them to meet [[Inam]] who revealed that [[Croissant]], who were missing this whole time is actually selling stuffs nearby. They are reunited later in the market. Several people later asked for help saying a "freak" with big blade is attacking other tribesmen. Croissant later deduced it has to be [[Utage]]. Gavial later asked Utage what is she doing and she only replied that she just wanted to fight but Inam later said that she looked like she's an odd being to their eyes much to her confusion.<ref>[[RI-5/Story]]</ref>[[Blaze]] later also reunited with them with the help of [[Flint|Kemar]].They later go to a nearby waterfall to have some fun but Ceobe suddenly said she wants to fight again and headed straight to Zumama's tribe area.<ref>[[RI-6/Story]]</ref> The effect of the hallucinogenic mushroom later wears off much to everyone's relief.<ref>[[RI-7/Story]]</ref>

Eunectes, who had enough, then challenged Gavial into a fight. She admits that she considered Gavial her biggest obstacle because whenever she tried to taught the tribesmen about machinery they ignored her and wants to be Gavial instead. Zumama challenged her alongside the [[Beast Lord]] known only as [[High Priest]], who revealed to Croissant he knows [[Emperor]] as well much to her shock. Gavial later defeated them and earned her rights as the Great Chief. However, she still decided to leave them.<ref>[[RI-8/Story]]</ref> Tomimi refused to accept the fact she's leaving and tried to coerce Gavial into staying by telling everyone to subdue her. Gavial defeated them all but it's revealed that they're holding Dylan, the pilot and Lancet-2 hostage. Unbeknownst to them all, they're both only acting much to Gavial's surprise and delight. The Doctor later revealed they knew Tomimi's plans. In the end, Gavial nominated Inam to be the Great Chief in her place instead.<ref>[[RI-9/Story]]</ref>

===Break the Ice===
The Doctor, invited by Enciodes Silverash, came to Kjerag with [[Cliffheart]] and [[Sharp]] and [[Aurora]] accompanying them alongside [[Courier]]. During their sightseeing in Kjerag, the Doctor heard an unknown voice talking to them. Courier reunited with [[Matterhorn]] later who informed him of Kjerag's rapid development during his absence. Meanwhile, Sharp and Aurora went and set up some comms station installation spots. Afterwards, he told her not to follow him and the rest of the group to take a break and visit her family who lives in the area as per the Doctor's wishes. They later boarded the train where Cliffheart told them about Kjerag's area.<ref>[[BI-1/Story]]</ref> However, they are forced to take shelter due to heavy snowfall in the mountain after they got off the train. Gulo, with the Paleroches' men suddenly barged in, saying he wants to take the Doctor with him to the Paleroches estate, much to Cliffheart's confusion. [[Degenbrecher]] then followed suit and affirmed his statement. Sharp however, readies his weapon to which the Doctor replies he should ease up. The Doctor then told them all that they're going to do as Gulo's order and everything will be fine. When they arrived, [[Arctosz Paleroche]] clearly showed his disapproval to their presence and told [[Valais]] to escort them to their room in the estate. Cliffheart then confronted his brother, asking if he's really going to let this happen. He assured her that they'll be fine and then ordered Matterhorn to have someone keep an eye on them in the Paleroches' area. After conversing with Degenbrecher, he wondered if the Doctor saw through his plans. While the Doctor is in their room, the unknown voice, who revealed herself talked to them. The unknown voice revealed themselves as [[Kjera]].<ref>[[BI-ST-1]]</ref> 

They later met Courier when he tried to quell a protest and knew he asked for their help in calming the protestors. He apologized for dragging them to Kjerag's own problem and assured them that the Silverashes will protect them.<ref>[[BI-2/Story]]</ref> Unfortunately, an unknown group of people tried to attack the Doctor and they were saved by Sharp and Aurora. After they get to safety, Sharp noticed the unknown assailants were ill-equipped and Aurora concluded that they're there to slander the Browntails. They still don't have enough evidences and the Doctor is forced to go back. However, when they returned, Aurora recognized one of the assailant as her brother. The Doctor, under pretense of examining the factory, started listing out reasons that might led to the factory's closure. Valais then chastised the assailant for their assault attempt with Aurora following suit. The Doctor however told Valais to let them go because Aurora's brother is involved. Valais, who accompanied the Doctor, also deduced that something in the incident doesn't add up. Artocsz, who shared the sentiment is warned by the Doctor that by looking amicable, the unknown faction no longer needs to hide themselves which led to an explosion outside.<ref>[[BI-3/Story]]</ref> 

They later rushed outside to meet Cliffheart and Sharp who were briefed over an unknown group of soldier.<ref>[[BI-ST-2]]</ref> They were seen attending the Holy Hunt ceremony later where they met Kjarr, the [[Pramanix|Saintess]]' handmaiden. She explains to them what the Holy Hunt is and gave them a tour around the Vine-Bead Court.<ref>[[BI-5/Story]]</ref> They realized however that Enciodes is indeed in deep trouble, which Kjarr herself sort of confirms. She doesn't know why the Doctor themselves were deeply concerned but the Doctor replied there's a huge misunderstanding for everyone involved. Kjarr herself knows the extent of his plans but the Doctor said there's another possibility that she didn't know. This possibility however, is proven true when Degenbrecher subdued [[Gnosis]] in public and the Doctor told Sharp to rescue Ratatosk and Artocsz much to his confusion warning that Kjerag is undergoing "tectonic changes".<ref>[[BI-ST-3]]</ref>

Kjarr realized that Enciodes' objective is to secure the Vine-Bead Court in the literal way. The Doctor later were informed of Ratatosk and Artosz's return to their own territories. They reunited later in the Paleroches' estate and informed both Artocsz and Ratatosk of their plan.<ref>[[BI-7/Story]]</ref> Aurora later told Cliffheart, who were told to stay out of her brother's plan that the Doctor decided to make a move and asked her to ensure her sister is able to go to the summit. The Doctor is seen later with [[Sciurus Browntail]] and Gulo watching their plan unfolds. Degenbrecher arrived later, after sensing their involvement and Sharp proposed them to a duel. The Doctor, with Aurora, finally comes face-to-face with Enciodes, who were confronted by the Paleroches but Pramanix decided to descend the summit in the same time while the darkened clouds cleared up displaying her blessing as the Saintess.<ref>[[BI-8/Story]]</ref> The Doctor is later seen playing chess with Enciodes, where he revealed his full plans and asked for their assistance. He affirmed his decision to partner with Rhodes Island and told the Doctor that Kjerag will undergo massive changes. In the aftermath, the Doctor is seen busy browing souvenirs and [[Dobermann]] picked them up and hoped they're involved in big events, much to everyone's disagreement without words. Dobermann then sighed and expect full report of the events.<ref>[[BI-ST-4]]</ref>

===Operational Intelligence===
The Doctor comes across [[Flamebringer]], who has recently joined Rhodes Island. They are unaware of who he is and walk passes him after excusing themselves.<ref>[[Destroyer]]</ref>

The Doctor gives [[Ifrit]] homework and prevents her from going on a cleanup mission with [[Silence]], much to her annoyance. Later on, the Doctor appears just as Ifrit calms down from her rampage, noticing that she nearly burned the corridor down. They commend her for suppressing the Diablo and give her her favourite dried peppers. Ifrit hands over her charred homework to the Doctor and promises to apologize to the people she troubled. Nevertheless, the Doctor gives Ifrit the opportunity to take part in an operation and to come along [[Heart of Surging Flame/Synopsis|to the beach]] after she apologizes.<ref>[[After-class Homework]]</ref>

===Stories of Afternoon===
The Doctor finds [[Vanilla]] in the training grounds, having just finished a session. Just as the Doctor expected, she asks them to help take care of her pet [[Originium]] slugs and a desert metal crab. The Doctor jokes about eating them, much to Vanilla's horror, before suggesting she simply ask anyone she comes across for help.<ref>[[Let's Throw a Party!]]</ref>

===Children of Ursus===
[[Amiya]] brings up the topic of [[Rosa|Natalya]]'s transfer application to the Doctor, who decides to check on Natalya at Amiya's request. They encounter [[Zima]] in the hallways, who is then scolded by [[Nearl]]. Zima leaves, not before claiming she will get to boss them around one day. Nearl explains that Zima does not take well to discipline and suffers from confusion, but says she likes her for her integrity. Later, the Doctor is greeted by [[Gummy]] and watches as the girl asks [[Perfumer]] to teach her how to cook with spices before helping [[Matterhorn]] out in the kitchen. Perfumer muses that she once got worried from hearing Gummy's sleep-talking when she fell asleep in her workshop, but says they will be okay in time.

After Perfumer leaves, [[Istina]] appears and remarks she has never seen the Doctor in the cafeteria before. She says she will be going to attend Hypatia's history class, as it could provide her with some inspiration. The Doctor asks about Natalya's whereabouts, and Istina says she is likely preparing for transfer. The Doctor goes to the training room, where they find Natalya and [[Leto]] training under [[Dobermann]]. Dobermann greets the Doctor but tells them they should be resting during lunchtime. She surmises that Amiya must have sent them, understanding her plight, but says they can only teach them how to fight and protect themselves.

Returning to see Amiya, the Doctor asks if she saw something in them. Amiya answers that occasionally she senses immense emotions from them. The Doctor asks if they can help them, to which Amiya replies they cannot force them to open up or help unprompted. The Doctor reassures Amiya that she is doing the right thing, and together they agree on approving Natalya's application.<ref>[[Business as Usual]]</ref>

===Rewinding Breeze===
The Doctor informs [[Arene]] to get a weapon reliability certificate. After a while, Arene returns with falsified signatures, which the Doctor sees through instantly. Arene promises to get the real signatures as he now thinks spending a little more time is worth it, having met a lot of interesting people.<ref>[[Expatriates]]</ref>

The Doctor met [[Mint]] and asked her if she's already adapted to Rhodes Island life. She replies energetically, recounting that [[Skyfire]] is helping her to understand stuff and that there was nothing to worry about. A HR operator approaches the Doctor asking for help. The HR operator asked for their help in locating [[Phantom]] who is deliberately avoiding people. The conversation continued towards operators with similar behavior such as [[Ethan]] and [[Manticore]], the latter whom the Doctor noted as having her own anxiety and it took them much effort just to have her sign the papers. Feeling lost, the Doctor implored the HR Operator to seek the Madam's help — Phantom's cat companion, [[Miss.Christine]]. In his room, Phantom is aware Miss.Christine brought guests with her: Mint, the Doctor and the HR operator. The HR operator asked questions in regards to his personal life, specifically his place of birth, [[Calais-Blason]]. The operator could not find any trace of the place, and Phantom apologized for any inconveniences caused. Phantom's mutterings of someone telling him to go to Rhodes Island causes the trio to theorize whether he needed another medical checkup. The Doctor then noticed an [[Phantom/Gallery#Focus|odd outfit]] in Phantom's wardrobe which sends him into a panic.<ref>[[Crisscrossing Shadows]]</ref>

===The Rides to Lake Silberneherze===
The Doctor made an appearance near the end, having been invited by [[Muelsyse]] to tag along with her to [[Kjerag]]. Representing Rhine Lab, Muelsyse was formally invited by [[SilverAsh|Enciodes Silverash]] to discuss the construction of the Starpod Research Base on the foot of Mount Karlan and to attend the ceremony celebrating the finished construction of the [[Kjeragandr]] statue.<ref>[[RS-8/Story]]</ref>

===To The Grinning Valley===

===Path of Life===
The Doctor arrived in [[Gran Faro]] three months after the events of [[Stultifera Navis]] where Skadi waited for them. They were supposed to meet [[Elysium]] after he deployed a data-collecting equipment in the Iberian sea, but the Inquisition's review process took way too much time.<ref>[[BP-ST-1]]</ref> After that, with the [[Abyssal Hunter]]'s escort, they and Kal'tsit departed to Milliarium. The Doctor noticed that the city is humid and have different air pressure compared to the land ones. Kal'tsit then tried to jog their memories back asking if the city reminds them of something but the Doctor didn't recall anything even with [[Preserver]]'s help. Kal'tsit then warned them that their arrival alongside the Abyssal Hunters gave them unwarranted attention. Skadi and [[Specter]] then arrived to meet the two back after their physical examination but they noticed [[Gladiia]] is missing. Specter then replied that [[Clementia|"Some troublesome fellow"]] wanted to talk to her. After assuring them she's alright Specter offered the Doctor a tour of the city which they happily obliged to. The Doctor keeps getting curious about Aegir's civilization with Skadi and Specter explaining to them what's what in their tour. Noticing a beacon launcher, they asked Specter what it's used for where she explained that the Aegir's dream is to go beyond the [[Starpod|sea of stars]]. Kal'tsit remarked that Kristen's research was correct to assume it's not impossible for them.<ref>[[BP-1/Story]]</ref> 

They were later seen in the Sophontheatrum with the Abyssal Hunters for their tribunal witnessed by [[Lumen]]. They later remarked how they were always involved in "delicate situations" and Kal'tsit affirmed that sentiment, saying that this is an important affair of the sea and the land. Due to the overwhelming's pressure from the audience, the Doctor decided to step back and sit down. When suddenly an unknown presence accosted them silently threatening to crush their throat. The unknown presence is later revealed to be [[Ulpianus]], who managed to silently enter Milliarium without anyone's notice. Ulpianus then explains how the mere presence of the Abyssal Hunters causes so much unrest with the Aegir citizen. He suddenly stopped when [[Blandus]] stepped up to the Abyssal Hunters and assured that he'll take them under his control. When a researcher voiced her concern of Ulpianus' missing presence, he scoffed at the reaction with the Doctor noting that if he comes out it will make things worse. When Blandus was asked about how will he handle Ulpianus the Doctor noticed that they had pretty close relationship to which Ulpianus didn't answer. They later noticed that he's gone after Blandus took a glance at them and the Doctor is forced to sit awkwardly.<ref>[[BP-2/Story]]</ref>
They were later able to track Ulpianus down in the city after the tribunal ended. He later asked the Doctor how much do they know about the ''Waterway Program'' and said there is [[Church of the Deep|another threat]] in the city. They then proposed Ulpianus to work with them for ease of access to the city which he accepted. Ulpianus then told the Doctor to watch Skadi closely. They then asked if she's alright after Specter and Gladiia were dispatched to exterminate Seaborns near the Milliarium area. They asked if Skadi's afraid of being the cause of Abyssal Hunter's demise to which she says maybe. She does however assure them that the Hunters themselves knows their own situation however, she also said that for this occasion, it might not be just for them but the whole Aegir. She then recounted her memories with him when she was still in her squad.<ref>[[BP-3/Story]]</ref>

Ulpianus and the Doctor later found out Tullia mutated into a Seaborn and were forced to infiltrate the C-22 Lab. They later hatched a plan where the Doctor will act as a distraction so Ulpianus can go inside. The Doctor then acts as a decoy and started talking with Blandus about his research where they offered to help him. They also talked about the Abyssal Hunters' recovery process to which they noticed one of them have awakened. Blandus then bid them farewell and they exited the lab to reunite with Ulpianus. Ulpianus confirmed that he had gathered sufficient evidences to conclude that someone or an unknown group tampered with the Waterway Program coordination. The Doctor later said that they knew what happened to Skadi. Ulpianus then revealed the truth that near the vicinity of where they found [[Ishar-mla]] he discovered an old Aegir equipment. The Doctor also noticed something odd that once the Hunters awakened from their sleep they immediately head out but he noticed Blandus seems to be more anxious than any of them. Ulpianus, sensing something wrong then said they need to move quickly. The Doctor decided to go straight to meet Clementia.<ref>[[BP-5/Story]]</ref>

Clementia revealed that she's essentially "forced" to order them for an urgent mission since the Legion's force are focused elsewhere but she also noticed the Doctor found something odd in the city. The Doctor then revealed that the beacon-weapon link was tampered and Clementia, sensing the urgency, then immediately orders all the Legion commanders to assist the Hunters. She then offered an explanation of her actions to which Kal'tsit says it doesn't matter since she knows the Hunters better than them but questioned her in regards to their survival. She then confessed that even Blandus' words during the tribunal didn't lessen her worries. The Abyssal Hunters project still bothers her, noting that Aegir didn't manage to successfully create another Hunter post the current active four. They all mutated into Seaborn or died in the process. The Doctor have a theory about them but Clementia also don't know what it is. When the Little Handy responded that Blandus didn't pick up her call, Clementia then apologize to both of them and leave to perform her duty.<ref>[[BP-6/Story]]</ref>

Clementia then orders lockdowns for all of their Class IV weapons and Kal'tsit noticed that there's a large swarm of Seaborn near Millarium that hadn't been detected. Clementia concluded that Blandus is the one tampering the Waterway Project and told the Doctor and Kal'tsit to leave the city and she'll be the their escort. During their trek however, the Doctor noticed that the city's system has been seriously breached after seeing a cable in Clementia's hand twitching endlessly. Near the exit however, an unknown Seaborn confronted them. Kal'tsit summoned Mon3tr to defend them. Clementia noticed something odd about said Seaborn and it started talking in Aegirian language. The Seaborn then talked about how it left the city for posterity's sake and Clementia came into realization that she's talking to [[Mártus]], the missing expedition member of the mantle ruins two centuries ago. He then displayed his knowledge of the [[Predecessor]], even referring to Kal'tsit as her real name. Kal'tsit then conversed with him with Martus revealing that he met a [[Feranmut]] in the ruins. When Martus revealed he deliberately created the Church of the Deep, the Doctor accused him of tricking his followers, to which he defended his actions as a means of survival. The Doctor, angry at his action then asked if he actually knows '''whose''' survival is he talking about. Clementia then steps forward, having enough of his talk, severed his connection to the terminal with her sword.<ref>[[BP-7/Story]]</ref>

The Doctor and Kal'tsit then rejected his views of survival, noting that all livings being deserves to decide how to survive on their own. Clementia then revealed that they're excising the Seaborn quickly in the city to which Martus responds that they might be successful for now but his next mission is to awaken the next [[Firstborn]]. After his retreat, Clementia told the Doctor and Kal'tsit that they need to establish formal relationship. Kal'tsit then replied that the Doctor needs to do some stuff first. They then went to look for Skadi who confronted Martus. Martus asked how did they know each other and the Doctor replied she's an operator of Rhodes Island. Martus replied with ominous note that they have inseparable connection. The Doctor, however managed to ensure their promise to Ulpianus to watch over Skadi.<ref>[[BP-8/Story]]</ref>

===Ancient Forge===
In the ''Ancient Forge'' movie, the Doctor arrives at [[Lungmen]] with [[Amiya]] and shows surprise at the festive atmosphere. They ask her about [[Nian]], having neglected to listen to the previous explanation, and the two attends a meeting with [[Fumizuki]]. The Doctor has yet to find [[Lava]], so Amiya asks if they can register an operator without her presence. The meeting is interrupted by a report from an officer about unidentified personnel appearing in the city center.<ref>[[Ancient Forge I]]</ref>

The Doctor and Amiya dispatch operators to assist the [[L.G.D.]] in securing the urban districts. As the terracotta soldiers continue to adapt, the Doctor asks if they can help with anything else, prompting Fumizuki to bestow command authority equal to that of Ch'en upon them to help deal with the Nian threat.<ref>[[Ancient Forge II]]</ref>

===Delicious on Terra===
Following the arrival of [[Laios]]'s party, the Doctor briefly interacts with them, notably remaining calm even when faced with Laios's unusual and direct questions about the biology of the various races. The Doctor also joins in the feast, cooking instant noodles in their mouth by pouring boiling hot water.<ref>[[DT-8/Story]]</ref>

==Operator Records==
:''{{Color|code=00FFFF|Please note that the Operator Records below may not be necessarily listed in a chronological order.}}''

===Noir Corne: The Other Side of the Deck===
The Doctor goes to relax at the bar at Amiya's suggestion. There, they see [[Noir Corne]] and other operators drinking and playing cards. They greet the operators by name, and assure Noir Corne that it is just their duty to remember the operators. As the other operators excuse themselves, the Doctor lets Noir Corne sit with them and offers him a snack. In return, Noir Corne invites the Doctor for a drink.<ref>[[Noir Corne/Operator Record]]</ref>

===Castle-3: Immortal===
During a mission, [[Castle-3]] brings the [[Doctor]] to the safest rest area and joins the operators for breakfast. An old voice recorder plays, and Castle-3 is told by the Doctor not to eliminate it just yet, but he removes its power source when the recorder falls apart. The Doctor and the operators drink to Shaver, a deceased operator who owned the recorder. Castle-3 asks the Doctor when the others start singing and notes that he cannot master the technique and does not understand what immortal means. At Chiave's request, Castle-3 leaves to bring him his tools, and the Doctor comes along.

On the way, Castle-3 expresses his gratitude to the Doctor, who asks him about his scars, which were made to memorialize an incident. The Doctor states that he is learning, which Castle-3 denies. When Castle-3 says that his shell might remain for some time after his functions cease, the Doctor expresses hope that he will be placed in special storage and that they will remember every battle they fought together. Chiave interrupts them with a transmission, and the Doctor is surprised when Castle-3 admits that [[Closure]] might stop his functions that day because of his core. Castle-3's sensors detect hostiles, and they eventually escape, with the Doctor having climbed on top of the robot. The Doctor tells him to keep running as they listen to his attempt at singing.

They return to the landship, where Castle-3 gives his final words to the Doctor and enters sleep mode, to Closure's confusion. Inspired by the Doctor's musing, Closure upgrades Castle-3. Later, the Doctor asks Castle-3 about his memory bank, just before Chiave enters the room. The Doctor correctly guesses that Chiave got anxious, and the [[Vulpo]] admits he almost yelled at Closure. Castle-3 ponders that they will still be able to run freely for a long time, a sentiment that the Doctor agrees with, and offers to play a song with his jukebox.<ref>[[Castle-3/Operator Record]]</ref>

===SilverAsh: Unpredictable===
The Doctor and [[Amiya]] receive reports that the batch of analgesics sent to the newly established [[Karlan Trade]] branch was instead pawned off to a nearby black market. The amnesiac Doctor asks more about [[Silverash]] and learns that he has been a major client since a year ago, even going so far as to personally distribute the analgesics to his [[Infected]] employees when a medic operator wanted to test him. The Doctor decides to approach the problem by sending an informant, disguised as a new Infected recruit, to the Karlan Trade branch. The operator, with the Doctor listening in through a communicator, learns that the workers are happy with their conditions, but their painkillers are distributed as a best-performance reward by the branch manager, while the workers are forced to lie that everyone received the painkillers.

They manage to eavesdrop on a conversation between the branch manager and his agent and learn that Enciodes Silverash is not involved in the matter. When Enciodes visits the branch two days later, the Rhodes Island informant pretends to suffer an [[Oripathy]] attack and reveals to Enciodes that he received no medicine, then plays the recording of the branch manager's conversation. To the operator's amazement, Enciodes is unafraid of his Oripathy and even calms the other employees. But once they are left alone, Enciodes feigns interest in the branch manager's scheme and claims that the disappearance of one employee would not affect the company. He takes the hidden terminal from the informant and asks why they should treat the Infected well, prompting the Doctor to tell him to stop his farce, finding his sincerity sufficient. Enciodes had only been acting to fish out information on the branch manager, and he thanks the manager for helping restore Karlan Trade's reputation in Rhodes Island's eyes, though he admonishes him for the poor results. He apologizes to the Infected employees, claims that the undercover team are investigators he summoned, and even has Rhodes Island provide free on-site medical examinations.

Later, the Doctor speaks with Enciodes and asks when he first learned of their plan. Enciodes praises the plan, noting that it would have borne fruit regardless of the outcome, and then asks whether he has met their expectations. Whatever answer the Doctor gives, their cooperation will continue, but Enciodes questions how important his views on the Infected are to Rhodes Island. The Doctor replies that it is indeed a very important factor for any partner of Rhodes Island. Enciodes excuses himself after receiving a phone call and says he looks forward to learning more from them if the Doctor knows how to play chess.<ref>[[SilverAsh/Operator Record 1]]</ref>

===SilverAsh: Unbreakable Ice===
During the briefing about [[Walden Caster|Viscount Walden]]'s request for Rhodes Island to rescue his daughter, the Doctor is told that their tour in [[Kjerag]] brought unexpected benefits, as proven by the valuable commission that [[SilverAsh|Enciodes]] brought to Rhodes Island. [[Kal'tsit]] says she does not intend to pry into the Doctor's relationships but reminds them that they have to be careful with Enciodes and not get tangled up with [[Victoria|Victorian]] figures beyond a business capacity, as it would be dangerous for both the Doctor and Enciodes.

During the meeting with Enciodes, the Doctor listens as he recounts his family's exploration of the outside world. Enciodes explains that the Viscount is worried that his actions may have provoked his daughter's kidnapping, and as such, he is willing to employ any means necessary. The Doctor thanks an operator who has located Kate and the kidnappers and is then asked by Enciodes about a presumptuous request to talk with the kidnappers, as their boss is actually Kate's brother, [[Carle Caster|Carle]]. The Doctor is noted to have a different reaction to Carle after listening to his story. Afterwards, they leave with Enciodes, and the Doctor answers his question, confirming that he did not go out of line and acted as he usually did with Carle. They notice Carle heading out alone into the city. After they follow and witness him begging a merchant for an anti-infection device for his sister, the Doctor instructs an operator to prepare a spare protective suit and asks Enciodes if he is surprised. Enciodes admits he is and calls out to Kate, who has been following them. Kate apologizes and asks them to help her brother, explaining that he cares nothing about himself or the ransom.

The Doctor receives the spare protective suit from an operator and asks him for his opinion on the ordeal. The operator deduces that Carle is aiming for either murder or suicide after securing the ransom for his friends. As the Doctor prepares to approach Carle's camp again, Enciodes apologizes and asks the Doctor how important his answer to the [[Infected]] question is. The Doctor replies that it is very important and that Rhodes Island will continue its current methods. The Doctor then asks Enciodes what he will use to bargain for Carle's life. 

Three days later, Rhodes Island has helped the Infected group enough that Carle has come to trust the Doctor. As they wait in the barrens, Carle expresses his disbelief that someone like the Doctor would know Enciodes, and asks them to take care of Kate and his brothers if anything happens. Enciodes shows up instead of the Viscount to complete the transaction, but a number of Victorian soldiers appear, so the Doctor orders the operators to not attack the soldiers and ensure the Infected group's safety. Later, Enciodes returns to the Doctor's side. He laments that he failed to connect them with the Viscount but notes he has earned a new perspective, promising to pay them back one day.

Back at Rhodes Island, the Doctor listens as Kal'tsit reflects that the outcome was a resounding failure, though she notes that the Doctor took the correct action and it wasn't completely fruitless. She hands the Doctor a document, a temporary operator cooperation request from SilverAsh. Surprised, they learn that Enciodes accepted Kal'tsit's conditions, passed the operator exam with flying colors, and is currently waiting for them in the reception room. Kal'tsit suggests that the Doctor should give him a tour of the landship. The Doctor then confronts him, to which Enciodes claims that he was naturally concerned about Ensia and decided to follow suit in joining. When pressed again about his motives, Enciodes admits he wishes to become the Doctor's friend. As the Doctor lists the people already close to him, Enciodes counters that he unwillingly designates their roles in his path to progress. He cannot share his full burden with any of them due to their ties to Kjerag. The Doctor continues to question his decision to join Rhodes Island, Enciodes admits he failed to adequately consider the Infected. He insists that he must learn more about the Infected and Rhodes Island by working with the Doctor, reasoning that friends ought to see each other from time to time. The Doctor eventually accepts his reasoning. Enciodes then reminds them that they are still responsible for showing him around the landship, adding that despite his surprising actions, the Doctor will be glad to see him next time.<ref>[[SilverAsh/Operator Record 2]]</ref>

===Istina: Let's Go, Let's Go===
On the day of the food festival, the Doctor and [[Amiya]] visit the booth run by the [[Ursus Student Self-Governing Group|U.S.S.G.]] girls. When Amiya asks for their opinion, the Doctor praises [[Istina]] for doing a fine job of making the puzzle uncomplicated yet subtle. They fall silent as they continue eating, earning a reminder from Amiya to show more restraint.<ref>[[Istina/Operator Record 1]]</ref>

===Blacknight: Souls of the Wilderness===
The Doctor acts as a confidant for [[Mulberry]], listening to her talk about struggling to handle [[Blacknight]] as her assigned guide and temporary roommate. The Doctor reassures her when Mulberry was saddened by Blacknight's resignation, perceiving it to be her fault.<ref>[[Blacknight/Operator Record]]</ref>

===Executor the Ex Foedere: Azure===
The Doctor listens to [[Executor the Ex Foedere|Federico]]'s mission report and replies that they will go to [[Laterano]] if time permits. They then ask Federico what color their party hat should be, remarking that others think his color coordination looks good. To the Doctor's disappointment, Federico explains that his uniform is not something he personally chose.

They later attend an art exhibition with several young Operators, and the Doctor is surprised that Federico is accompanying them. When Federico asks why the Doctor is present despite not having notified the [[Notarial Hall]], the Doctor insists that the children wanted them to come along. While standing before a painting, the Doctor and Federico discuss the artist's use of blue. The artist is soon revealed to be Simeone, an [[Apostolic Knight]] whose extensive use of blue stands in stark contrast to his volatile temperament. The exhibition proceeds smoothly until the guests are instructed to evacuate due to an emergency. The Doctor only returns after the situation has been resolved, then learns that Federico had detonated a leftover bomb on the rooftop to prevent casualties, inadvertently damaging the painted dome and revealing the blue sky above. In that moment, Federico recalls his encounter with the Doctor after a rescue mission, during which he showed them a drawing of a blue sky given to him by a child.

Federico informs the Doctor that he resolved the incident but did not complete the mission, and the Doctor tells him to look at the sky. He and the Doctor continue watching it for an hour and a half. By the end of that time, Federico requests a medical checkup to determine whether the effects of the blue hue on his pathological condition have any impact on his performance. Three days later, the Doctor assists him with the request. The Doctor is surprised when Federico recommends that they choose azure for their boutonniere, and reveals that they will be attending a funeral, causing Federico to retract his suggestion. Before departing, Federico correctly identifies the navy blue of the Doctor's coat, which amuses the Doctor.<ref>[[Executor the Ex Foedere/Operator Record]]</ref>

===Kal'tsit: End of A Long Journey===
The Doctor is given a medical checkup earlier than scheduled, with Kal'tsit reasoning that the battlefield is particularly harsh on them. The Doctor brings up how [[Warfarin]] had kicked her out of Medical, which led to the current situation where Kal'tsit now conducts the checkup outside the department. The Doctor points out that others are worried about her, then shifts the topic to their ongoing Originium research. Curious, they ask why she chose to become a doctor. Kal'tsit answers that it was a method she had never tried before, but that two hundred years of practicing medicine had granted her far more than she lost. She expresses gratitude to the person who entrusted her with the mission, and the Doctor expresses happiness at seeing her open up. When they remark that it will be a long day, Kal'tsit smiles.<ref>[[Kal'tsit/Operator Record]]</ref>

===Utage: The Tale of Nuegiri===
Listening to the other version of the Nuegiri story, the Doctor notes that they arrived at the part about the brutal and arrogant ''daimyo''. They confirm that they are expecting a delivery of reports. When the landship's alarm suddenly blares, the Doctor realizes it is an alarm from the storage room and goes to inspect it with the others. Finding only a cartful of goods in the room, the Doctor observes the corridor and catches a sweet scent. The missing messenger is later found leaning against a door, far off his route, and the Doctor tells the others to let him rest in the lounge. Aware that [[Utage]] must have dealt with the messenger, they reassure that everything will be fine and that the man must have collapsed from exhaustion.<ref>[[Utage/Operator Record 2]]</ref>

===Civilight Eterna: As Time Itself===
The Doctor holds [[Amiya]]'s hands as she cries in her sleep. When she wakes up and remarks on the dark clouds, they agree that it is likely to rain. They ask her about her nightmare, and she admits that she had an exhausting dream with a happy ending. She wipes her tears and smiles at the Doctor.<ref>[[Civilight Eterna/Operator Record]]</ref>
